result.instructions: Tools for Billutant, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the invoices from last month that were never sent."; "Create a draft invoice for customer Acme with our two standard setup items."; "Which of our customers still have no e-mail address on file?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Billutant data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run billutant_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run billutant_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run billutant_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. billutant_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: billutant_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List the invoices of the connected Billutant account, with number, status, customer id and sent state. Billutant API: GET /invoices.

tools.name: billutant_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by id, including its number, status, files and sent state. Billutant API: GET /invoices/{id}.

tools.name: billutant_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List the customers of the connected Billutant account. Use their ids in billutant_create_invoice. Billutant API: GET /customers.

tools.name: billutant_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id. Billutant API: GET /customers/{id}.

tools.name: billutant_list_items
tools.title: List items
tools.description: List the products and services (items) that Billutant uses as invoice lines. Use their ids in billutant_create_invoice. Billutant API: GET /items.

tools.name: billutant_get_item
tools.title: Get an item
tools.description: Get one product or service (item) by id, with its name, price, tax and unit. Billutant API: GET /items/{id}.

tools.name: billutant_list_email_templates
tools.title: List e-mail templates
tools.description: List the e-mail templates used when Billutant sends an invoice. Use their ids as email_template_id. Billutant API: GET /email-templates.

tools.name: billutant_get_email_template
tools.title: Get an e-mail template
tools.description: Get one e-mail template by id, with its type, label, subject and body. Billutant API: GET /email-templates/{id}.

tools.name: billutant_create_invoice
tools.title: Create an invoice
tools.description: Create an invoice for an existing customer from existing item ids. Billutant sets the invoice date and number, and each call uses the next number in the sequence. draft=true saves a draft and sends nothing. send=true e-mails the customer and needs email_template_id; draft and send cannot both be true. Billutant API: POST /invoices.

item_ids.description: One or more item ids, in invoice line order.

draft.description: true = save as a draft (no number is final, nothing is sent).

send.description: true = e-mail the invoice to the customer now (needs email_template_id).

email_template_id.description: E-mail template id (from billutant_list_email_templates). Required when send is true.

tools.name: billutant_send_invoice
tools.title: Send an invoice
tools.description: E-mail an existing invoice that is not a draft to its customer, using an e-mail template. This sends mail to a real customer and cannot be undone. Billutant API: POST /invoices/{id}/send.
